result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both screenshots show the same first question, asking the barista to recall the target temperature rather than putting them at the steam wand. Both use the same distractor ranges, which are invented numbers, and 85 to 95 C is close to a throwaway option. A has slightly larger, more tablet-friendly type, while B says up front that an explanation follows each answer. Neither screenshot shows the feedback or the ending screen, so overall they are effectively equal. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): The two pages are nearly the same. Each has 7 questions and opens on the same question asking the barista to recall the 55 to 65 C target, with the same four options, so neither puts the barista in a real situation at the wand. A's subtitle says each answer comes with an explanation, while B has slightly larger, easier-to-read type for a tablet. Neither screenshot shows the feedback, the other questions or the ending, so items 3 and 5 are scored conservatively.
